audit.why: Syndra owns levels 1-5; Aurelion Sol takes over from first item at 51.04% across 1295 games. Content layer matched the packet chart, the full layer did not.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side flipped to Aurelion Sol to match win[5]/win[6] and the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer names Aurelion Sol's ultimate 'Voice of Light', which is not an ability in his kit.
audit.why: His R is Falling Star, upgrading to The Skies Descend once enough Stardust is banked; cooldown 120/110/100. 'Voice of Light' is a fabricated name and appears in whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid.
audit.corrected: Falling Star at 6; The Skies Descend upgrade and RoA/Seraph's as the real mid-game spikes. Syndra's spikes are 3 points of Q-E, and Unleashed Power at 6 (120/100/80).

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer states that Scatter the Weak cancels Aurelion Sol's channels, nor that Syndra's true damage ignores MR.
audit.why: Breath of Light (Q) and Astral Flight (W) are both interruptible channels; Scatter the Weak (E, 15s flat) is hard CC and ends either one — including dropping him out of flight. Transcendent (P) upgrades Force of Will (W) to deal bonus true damage, so stacking MR is not the answer against her. Her R has no CC, so it cannot cancel a channel by itself.
audit.corrected: Channel Q and commit W only once her E is spent; buy health and Zhonya's rather than raw MR.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns is a template with no numbers.
audit.why: Dark Sphere 7s, Force of Will 12/11/10/9/8, Scatter the Weak 15s flat, Unleashed Power 120/100/80, Astral Flight 22/20.5/19/17.5/16.
audit.corrected: Grounded in those numbers, with E as the punishable one.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization does not warn against raw MR.
audit.why: Her passive-upgraded W deals true damage and her R executes, so MR stacking underperforms here.
audit.corrected: Recorded in notes; report[8] left alone to avoid over-editing an otherwise correct build.

edits.before: Voice of Light gives you comparable range, letting you finally zone her rather than just surviving
edits.after: Falling Star gives you a stun she has to respect, letting you finally zone her rather than just surviving

edits.before: Unleashed Power (R) is a scary execute-range ultimate once she stacks spheres, but this is also exactly when your Voice of Light comes online, giving you the range to start answering her poke instead of just eating it.
edits.after: Unleashed Power (R) executes low targets from 675 range once she has spheres banked, but this is also exactly when Falling Star comes online, giving you a stun that punishes her for stepping up to line the combo.

edits.before: Level 6 flips the trade — Voice of Light gives you the range to poke and zone her, forcing her to spend spheres defensively rather than lining up a kill combo. Watch her sphere count carefully since her ultimate becomes a real execute threat on low-HP targets, but you can now contest priority instead of just playing scared.
edits.after: Level 6 flips the trade — Falling Star stuns her out of her combo setup, forcing her to hold spheres defensively rather than lining up a kill. Scatter the Weak is a flat 15s and it cancels both Breath of Light and Astral Flight, so channel only once it is spent. Watch her sphere count since Unleashed Power executes from 675 range, but you can now contest priority instead of playing scared.

edits.before: - Syndra Scatter the Weak (Stun): matchup-defining — The QE stun cone starts every kill combo — stay off the line between her and her orbs. Check it before every step-up. - W Astral Flight is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Scatter the Weak is a flat 15s at every rank and it cancels your Q and W channels — never start a beam while it is up. - Dark Sphere is 7s, so a whiffed Q costs her nothing; do not read it as a window. - Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: The QE stun cone starts every kill combo — stay off the line between her and her orbs. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Stay off the line between Syndra and her spheres — E only stuns through a sphere. Bait the 15s cooldown, then channel.

edits.before: W-flyby: fly a lateral arc, drag Q across Syndra for two seconds of burn + stacks, and land outside his answer range — repeat forever from one item.
edits.after: E the back three casters and let the execute finish them — you bank stardust from 750 range without ever entering her 650-range Scatter the Weak.

edits.before: Your flight is your only escape — a W spent poking is a death sentence against the next gank.
edits.after: Her E ends the channel mid-beam and leaves you standing in her sphere pile with nothing spent on her side.

edits.before: If Syndra takes first blood, tighten up: Scatter the Weak (Stun) is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with E executes and stay relevant through the stardust curve.
edits.after: If Syndra takes first blood, tighten up: an ahead Syndra kills from full through the E-stun, and her true damage means MR will not save you. A second kill ends the duel, not the game — clear with E executes and keep banking stardust.

notes: Content layer called Aurelion Sol's ultimate 'Voice of Light' in three places — a fabricated name, same class of error as 'Ares of Blaze'. Real name is Falling Star / The Skies Descend. Also fixed two level-chart disagreements: phases[5].side and phases[6].side said Syndra while win[5]/win[6] said Aurelion Sol; the packet chart backs Aurelion Sol, so the full layer was flipped. Itemization advice should discourage raw MR here (Transcendent upgrades Force of Will to true damage) but report[8] was left alone rather than expanded. Cleanse/QSS/tenacity behaviour on Scatter the Weak is not in Riot's text and was not asserted.
